# Power steering fluid service

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Identify and confirm the power steering fluid type by smearing samples on a white cloth. [t2018]

Drain the entire power steering system and pour in fresh power steering fluid. [t2289]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Identify the leak by wiping a sample on a white cloth to see if it appears orange or red.
2. [Partial] Confirm the fluid is power steering rather than engine oil, which turns black or brown when smeared.

_Procedure reported by [t2018]._

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t2289] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Drain the entire power steering system.
2. [Partial] Pour in fresh power steering fluid.

</details>
